correctness.rationale: The killed cycle Laplacian is strictly positive definite; exact quadratic arc interpolation solves the Poisson lifetime equations and yields a two-by-two trap system with positive determinant. The derivative with respect to the remote rate has exactly one root inside (0,K/4), and the optimized mean is strictly increasing in effective arc conductance C; C is minimized only at antipodal placements. Limits and allocation boundaries follow algebraically. A standalone standard-library checker independently confirmed 270 exact rational generator solves and 6750 seeded alternative allocations. Computations are diagnostics, not a substitute for all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Exact global optimization of finite reactive resources on a periodic transport network is a motivated design invariant. The theorem yields antipodal placement, a unique highly asymmetric allocation for every n>=3 and D,K>0, a strict one-quarter cap on remote reactivity, and a sharp factor-two lifetime reduction in the strong-reactivity limit relative to single-local or symmetric placement. These are substantive closed design laws beyond a generic inverse-generator identity; the scope excludes other initial distributions and geometries.
